2608.03883.title: DS@GT-ARC at eRisk 2026 Task 3: Sparse, Semantic, and LLM Reranking for ADHD Symptom Sentences
2608.03883.paper_summary: This paper describes our submissions to eRisk 2026 Task 3, ADHD Symptom Sentence Ranking. The task requires systems to rank candidate Reddit sentences according to their relevance to each of the 18 symptoms in the Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale (ASRS-v1.1). Because no annotated training data were released for this first edition of the task, we relied on zero-shot experimentation, manual validation, and unsupervised or weakly guided retrieval pipelines. Our systems combine sparse BM25 retrieval, evidence-aware rescoring for self-referential symptom reports, embedding-based reranking, query-prototype expansion, and LLM-based reranking. All submitted systems follow a staged retrieval design in which BM25 retrieves candidates at scale and semantic or LLM rerankers refine the final rankings. Among our submissions, the LLM reranker achieved the strongest official scores, followed by the prototype query-expansion run. Our manual top-10 analysis aligned with the official expert scoring trend, suggesting that staged reranking is a promising direction for further development.
2608.03883.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文描述了我們對 eRisk 2026 任務 3，ADHD 症狀句子排名的提交。<lb/>該任務要求系統根據與成人 ADHD 自我報告量表 (ASRS-v1.1) 中 18 個症狀的相關性對候選 Reddit 句子進行排名。<lb/>由於這個任務的第一版未發布任何註釋的訓練數據，我們依賴於零樣本實驗、手動驗證以及無監督或弱監督的檢索管道。<lb/>我們的系統結合了稀疏的 BM25 檢索、對自我參照症狀報告的證據感知重新評分、基於嵌入的重新排名、查詢原型擴展和基於 LLM 的重新排名。<lb/>所有提交的系統遵循分階段檢索設計，其中 BM25 大規模檢索候選項，而語義或 LLM 重新排名器則精煉最終排名。<lb/>在我們的提交中，LLM 重新排名器獲得了最強的官方分數，其次是原型查詢擴展運行。<lb/>我們的手動前 10 分析與官方專家評分趨勢一致，這表明分階段重新排名是一個有前景的進一步發展方向。
